spread_description: The flow of a situation across time: past, present and future.

cards.position_meaning: Roots and events already shaping the situation.
cards.name: Five of Wands
cards.meaning: Five figures clash their wands in spirited contest, a struggle of egos that sharpens rather than destroys.

cards.position_meaning: The current dynamics and where you stand now.
cards.name: Nine of Wands
cards.meaning: A weary guardian leans on his wand, bandaged yet standing, almost through the final test of endurance.

cards.position_meaning: The likely direction if things continue as they are.
cards.name: Nine of Pentacles
cards.meaning: A poised woman stands in her abundant vineyard, a falcon on her hand, enjoying self-made independence.

synthesis: Reading the Three Card (时间之流三张). Past (过去) draws Five of Wands (权杖五) upright, highlighting disagreement, competition, strife. Present (现在) draws Nine of Wands (权杖九) upright, highlighting courage, persistence, test of faith. Future (未来) draws Nine of Pentacles (星币九) upright, highlighting luxury, self-sufficiency, financial independence. No Major Arcana appeared, so the reading turns on everyday, practical forces you can act on directly rather than on larger destiny-level themes. Every card fell upright, suggesting these energies express themselves clearly and without obstruction.
